sections.heading: Pre-release terms
paragraphs: {brand} is a pre-release game and service. These terms cover playing the game in your browser and the password accounts that exist while it is being built. They have not been reviewed by counsel and will be replaced before launch.
The service can change, pause or reset at any time. Accounts and anything attached to them can be removed without notice during the pre-release period.

sections.heading: Who may use it
paragraphs: You must be 18 or older to play. The game asks for your date of birth once, keeps only the fact that you are 18 or older, and does not keep or send the date. If you tell us you are younger than 18, the game stays closed on that device.
Creating an account or signing in also means you confirm that you are 18 or older. If you tell us you are younger than 18, the account is closed and its record is deleted.

sections.heading: Your account
paragraphs: An account is a username and a password. There is no email address and no password recovery, so keep your password safe. If you lose it, the account cannot be recovered.
Pick a username that is yours to use. Names that imitate staff, the service itself, other companies or real people are refused.

sections.heading: How to behave
paragraphs: Do not attack the service, try to reach accounts that are not yours, or use it to break the law.
We may close an account that does this.

sections.heading: Game content
paragraphs: The game contains mature themes. It has no firearms and no gore. Characters, dialogue and some cutscenes are generated by AI and can be wrong. The characters and events are fiction.
{brand} is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any other publisher or game.

sections.heading: Diagnostics and gameplay analytics
paragraphs: When you accept these terms the game asks whether it may send diagnostics (errors and performance) and gameplay analytics (which pages and modes are used). Both are on by default. You can turn either off on that screen or later in Settings, under Data and privacy. Nothing is sent before you accept, and nothing is sent from a device that has been blocked by the age check.
The events carry no name, no free text and no save data. The privacy notice lists what is stored and who processes it.

sections.heading: No warranty
paragraphs: The pre-release service is provided as it is, without promises of availability or fitness for a purpose. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for loss caused by its use during the pre-release period.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these terms, and requests to delete or export your account data: {contact}.
